title: arXiv papers
description: The papers dataset and the run summary.

dataset.title: Papers
dataset.description: One row per id. Paid rows carry arxivId, version, title, authors, publishedAt, updatedAt, primaryCategory, categories, comment, journalRef, doi, absUrl, pdfUrl and billable true; every other row is a free status row with a reason and no paper. Status rows are written in batches of up to 100, so sort by actorIndex to get the input order back.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: Counters of the run: requested, attempted, delivered, chargedEvents, deliveredUncharged, deliveredUnverified, chargeUncertain, writeErrors, papersNotFound, papersInvalid, cutByLimit, byStatus, counterMismatch, stopReason, datasetNote, firstFailure and priceNote. A copy under RUN_SUMMARY-<runId> is kept in the named store arxiv-paper-summary.
